title: Nutrition & exercise
description: Food diary and exercise log in InfluxDB BodyStats (nutrition, exercise), next to every scale's weigh-ins.

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: IANA time zone the days and weeks are cut in (TRIBUTARY_TZ).

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "user"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "user"

list.name: source
list.label: Source
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.description: Single-select on purpose: the panels sum per day or week, which would merge two sources into one bar.

panels.title: Food days logged

targets.query: SELECT count("kcal") FROM (SELECT sum("energy_kcal") AS "kcal", count("energy_kcal") AS "meals" FROM "nutrition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')) WHERE $timeFilter

panels.description: Days with at least one meal logged in the range.

panels.title: Median intake

targets.query: SELECT median("kcal") FROM (SELECT sum("energy_kcal") AS "kcal", count("energy_kcal") AS "meals" FROM "nutrition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')) WHERE "meals" >= 3 AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Median of the daily calorie totals, counting only days with at least 3 meals logged, so a day with a lone snack logged does not pull it down.

panels.title: Median protein

targets.query: SELECT median("g") FROM (SELECT sum("protein_g") AS "g", count("energy_kcal") AS "meals" FROM "nutrition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')) WHERE "meals" >= 3 AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Median daily protein, on the same days as Median intake.

panels.title: Workouts

targets.query: SELECT count("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" != 'adjustment' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Logged workouts, device calorie adjustments excluded.

panels.title: Days with a workout

targets.query: SELECT count("n") FROM (SELECT count("energy_kcal") AS "n" FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" != 'adjustment' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')) WHERE $timeFilter

panels.description: Days with at least one workout logged.

targets.query: SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" != 'adjustment' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Calories eaten per day, by meal

targets.query: SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "nutrition" WHERE "meal" = 'breakfast' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "nutrition" WHERE "meal" = 'lunch' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "nutrition" WHERE "meal" = 'dinner' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "nutrition" WHERE "meal" = 'snacks' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.description: One stacked bar per logged day. A day with nothing logged is blank, not zero; a short bar with a single meal is a partly logged day.

panels.title: Workout calories per day, by activity

targets.query: SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'run' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'bike' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'strength' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'aerobic' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" !~ /^(run|bike|strength|aerobic|adjustment)$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.description: Calories burned as the app estimates them for each logged workout, per day (device adjustments excluded).

panels.title: Weight, every scale

targets.query: SELECT "weight_kg" FROM "body_composition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT "weight" / 1000 FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.description: Every weigh-in in BodyStats and garmin-grafana's, one colour per source.

panels.title: Share of calories from protein, carbs and fat

targets.query: SELECT sum("protein_g") * 4 AS "Protein", sum("carbs_g") * 4 AS "Carbs", sum("fat_g") * 9 AS "Fat" FROM "nutrition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.description: Per logged day, the energy from each macro as a share of the three: protein and carbs at 4 kcal/g, fat at 9 kcal/g.

panels.title: Logged days

targets.query: SELECT count("energy_kcal") AS "Meals", sum("energy_kcal") AS "kcal", sum("protein_g") AS "Protein", sum("carbs_g") AS "Carbs", sum("fat_g") AS "Fat", sum("fiber_g") AS "Fiber", sum("sugar_g") AS "Sugar", sum("sodium_mg") AS "Sodium" FROM "nutrition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.description: Daily totals from the food diary. Fiber, sugar and sodium are only what the logged foods reported, so they are lower bounds.

panels.title: Workout time per week, by activity

targets.query: SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'run' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'bike' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'strength' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'aerobic' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" !~ /^(run|bike|strength|aerobic|adjustment)$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.description: Logged workout duration per week (Monday to Sunday).

panels.title: Workout calories per week, by activity

targets.query: SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'run' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'bike' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'strength' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'aerobic' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" !~ /^(run|bike|strength|aerobic|adjustment)$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.description: Calories burned as the app estimates them for each logged workout, per week: an estimate from activity and duration, not a measurement.

panels.title: Device calorie adjustment per week

targets.query: SELECT sum("energy_kcal") FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" = 'adjustment' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.description: The extra calories the app added to the daily budget from a linked device: the activity it reported over the app's own estimate, not workouts.

targets.query: SELECT "activity" AS "Activity", "category" AS "Category", "duration_s" / 60 AS "Minutes", "energy_kcal" AS "kcal" FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" != 'adjustment' AND "user" = '$user' AND "source" = '$source' AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 2000
